# Applications


## Wildlife Monitoring

::: {#fig-intro-kora-lynx}

![Source: @breitenmoser-wursten_projekt_2024]({{< meta params.images_path >}}kora_lynx.png){width=70%}

Camera trap image — biologists need to know which species are present.
:::

::: {.fragment}
Deep learning automates species identification at scale (@Images2018).
:::


## Synthetic Image Generation & Detection

::: {#fig-intro-synthetic-images layout-ncol=2}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}application_synthetic_images_grta.png)

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}sid_trump.jpg)

Examples of synthetic images: left from @mathys_synthetic_2024, right from [Source](https://x.com/TheInfiniteDude/status/1637211568692932608).
:::

::: {.fragment}
Generation enables art and design — but also fuels deepfakes and motivates detection research (@mathys_synthetic_2024-1, @willi_synthetic_2026).
:::


## On-Device Photo Categorization & Safety

::: {#fig-intro-apple-safety}
![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}apple_nude_safety.png){width=55%}

Apple's on-device safety features — sensitive content detection while preserving privacy. [Source](https://www.apple.com/child-safety/)
:::

## Self-Driving

{{< video https://storage.googleapis.com/waymo-uploads/files/site-animations/waymo-driver/cameras.webm width=1400 >}}

[Example from Waymo](https://waymo.com/waymo-driver/) — simultaneous detection of vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, lanes, traffic signs.


## Face Recognition (Face ID)

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/z-t1h0Y8vuM?si=qnEOYDmqyv8zGvMV start="50" width=1200 height=600 >}}

[Apple Face ID](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102381) — infrared depth sensing creates a 3D facial map.


## Precision Agriculture

::: {#fig-intro-minneapple}

![Example from @hani_minneapple_2020]({{< meta params.images_path >}}minneapple.png){width=55%}

Counting apples on trees from images. Drones extend this to yield, type, and crop health estimation.
:::


## Medical Imaging

::: {#fig-intro-sam}

![Example from @ma_segment_2024.]({{< meta params.images_path >}}medsam.png){width=55%}

Generic segmentation model identifies organs and anatomical structures at the pixel level.
:::

# Computer Vision Tasks


## Core Task: Image Classification

::: {#fig-intro-image_clssifier}
![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}image_classification_example.png){width=55%}

Multi-class classification: predict the most likely class with confidence (@krizhevsky_imagenet_2012).
:::


## Core Task: Object Detection

::: {#fig-intro-yolo-example}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}yolo_object_detection_example.png){width=55%}

Bounding boxes localize multiple objects, each with a class and confidence (@Redmon2016a).
:::


## Core Task: Segmentation

::: {#fig-mask-rcnn-object-segmentation-example}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}instance_segmentation_example_maskrcnn.jpg){width=55%}

In segmentation, individual pixels are assigned to specific objects (instance segmentation, here) or classes (semantic segmentation). From @he_mask_2018.
:::



## Core Task: Generation


::: {#fig-intro-stylegan3 width=400}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}stylegan3_examples.png){width=400}


StyleGan3 (from @karras_alias-free_2021).
:::


## Beyond Core Tasks

Many applications are combinations or extensions of core tasks.


## Example: Keypoint Detection

::: {#fig-mask-rcnn-keypoint-detection-example}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}keypoint_detection_exampe_maskrcnn.jpg){width=55%}

Localize specific points (e.g. body joints) (@he_mask_2018).
:::

::: {.fragment}
**Quiz**: What core task(s) does keypoint detection combine?
:::

## Example: Colorization

::: {#fig-intro-colorization-example}

![Norwegian Bride (est. late 1890s) — DeOldify: [Link](https://github.com/jantic/DeOldify)]({{< meta params.images_path >}}colorization_example.png){width=55%}

Black-and-white → RGB.
:::

## Many More Tasks

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
- Image Classification
- Object Detection

- Image Segmentation

  - Instance Segmentation

- Pose Estimation
- Facial Recognition
- Action Recognition
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
- Image Generation
  - Style Transfer
  - Image Inpainting
  - Super-Resolution
  - Text-to-Image (and more)
- Image Captioning
- 3D Reconstruction
- Image Retrieval
:::

::::

List is not exhaustive!

## Videos {.center}

After all, videos are nothing but a sequence of images.
:::

3. Image search
4. Finding tumors in medical images

# Challenges


## Semantic Gap

::: {#fig-cat-number-grid}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}semantic_gap_comparison.png){width=60%}

Computers see numbers, humans see meaning.
:::

::: {.fragment}
Bridging raw pixels → high-level concepts is the central problem.
:::


## Viewpoint

::: {#fig-intro-challenge-viewpoint}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}viewpoint_challenge.png){width=60%}

Same object — wildly different pixels.
:::


## Deformation

::: {#fig-challenge-deformation}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}challenge_deformation.png){width=60%}

Living things bend, twist, curl. [Source](http://cs231n.stanford.edu/)
:::


## Illumination

::: {#fig-challenge-illumination}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}challenge_illumination.png){width=60%}

Lighting changes pixels dramatically. [Source](http://cs231n.stanford.edu/)
:::


## Background Clutter

::: {#fig-challenge-background}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}challenge_background.png){width=60%}

Foreground vs. background — when textures match. [Source](http://cs231n.stanford.edu/)
:::


## Occlusion

::: {#fig-challenge-occlusion}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}challenge_occlusion.png){width=60%}

Recognize from partial views. [Source](http://cs231n.stanford.edu/)
:::


## Intra-Class Variation

::: {#fig-challenge-intra-class}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}challenge_intra_class_variation.jpg){width=60%}

All cats — but very different. [Source](https://www.maxpixel.net/)
:::


## Context Dependence

::: {#fig-tiger-context}

![]({{< meta params.images_path >}}tiger_context.jpg){width=55%}

:::

::: {.fragment}
**Question:** Is this a tiger?
:::



## Context Dependence 2

::: {#fig-blop-context}
